headline: Quirno mentioned as a replacement for Caputo, but the government believes it would worsen market distrust
summary: Quirno has been mentioned as a possible replacement for Economy Minister Caputo, but the government believes it would worsen market distrust. Karina is reported to be wary of his high profile.
why: Argentina's economy minister sets fiscal and monetary direction, and leadership changes there influence investor confidence in Argentine assets.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Mencionan a Quirno como reemplazo de Caputo, pero en el gobierno creen que agravaría la desconfianza del mercado
